scope.question: R580 same-version dual-RM client/handle ownership for NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC, CONTROL, FREE and same-process GPU enumeration.
scope.method: Read-only static inspection of the pinned R580.178.04 source and SDK declarations.

source_pin.hashes: SHA-256 of the exact pinned archive and referenced source files; line numbers are relative to each source file.

namespace.observation: NVOS21, NVOS00 and NVOS54 contain numeric client/object handles, not an RM-instance identifier. Each request is resolved by whichever RM receives the ioctl.
namespace.rm_globals: R580 source has one global g_resServ and one static g_RmApiList; RM control resolves hClient through g_resServ.
namespace.implication: A usable dual-RM identity is (rm_domain, hClient) and (rm_domain, hObject). A bare hClient cannot route calls between cores. Two callbacks that enter the same stock g_resServ do not provide independent RM namespaces.

exact_request.hRoot: desired_hClient. First backend may use 0 and retain its returned ID; second backend requests that exact ID here.
exact_request.hClass: NV01_ROOT_CLIENT (0x41); NV01_ROOT (0x0) is accepted at the escape and rewritten to ROOT_CLIENT.
exact_request.endpoint: Control fd; root class requires NV_FLAG_CONTROL.
exact_request.why_null_parameters_are_valid: The ROOT_CLIENT resource descriptor is RS_OPTIONAL(NvHandle). rmapiGetClassAllocParamSize allows NULL and leaves the copied parameter size at zero. RmClientResource skips writing a class payload when pAllocParams is NULL. A separate 4-byte NvHandle payload is optional and may be used as an extra output cross-check.

alloc_root.explicit_id_verdict: Source-supported, conditional: src/nvidia/Makefile sets RS_COMPATABILITY_MODE=1. serverAllocClient keeps nonzero pParams->hClient in this mode. _serverCreateEntryAndLockForNewClient rejects duplicate handles and requires the requested ID to be available exactly in its bucket; otherwise allocation fails. This confirms hRoot=desiredID, not hObjectNew=desiredID, as the relevant selection field for the second root.
alloc_root.output_caveat: On the root path serverAllocClient sets hResource=hClient; _rmAlloc copies hResource to *hObjectNew even if serverAllocResource returns an error. The class-payload copyout is skipped on error, and RmClientResource only writes the optional pAllocParms value on success. Thus a nonzero hObjectNew accompanying an error is not proof of an active client and must not be freed blindly.
alloc_root.two_core_caveat: This source supports requesting a nonzero hClient within one RsServer. Mirroring it across two backends requires genuinely isolated RsServer/global RM state and exact backend dispatch; R580 stock globals are singular.

rm_control.code: NV_ESC_RM_CONTROL=0x2a; NVOS54_PARAMETERS fields are hClient, hObject, cmd, flags, params, paramsSize, status.
rm_control.routing: Escape requires the control fd, may resolve a GPU fd for command-specific references, and then passes hClient/hObject/cmd to Nv04ControlWithSecInfo. The payload has no RM-domain field.

root_enumeration_call.hClient: root client ID in selected RM domain

rm_free.routing: Control fd required; RM entry passes hRoot as hClient and hObjectOld as resource. Successful root free also frees OS events for that hRoot.
rm_free.exactness: Both fields are required: NVOS00.hRoot selects the client namespace, and hObjectOld must equal that root client handle to free the root resource. The resource server detects hClient == hResource, deactivates the client, and invokes its client-free path.

client_lifetime.observation: RmClient stores API_SECURITY_INFO.clientOSInfo. Strict validation checks pointer identity. The OS escape sets clientOSInfo to nvfp->ctl_nvfp, falling back to nvfp; osapi cleanup finds all clients registered under that OSInfo and disables/frees them from the one global g_resServ.
client_lifetime.register_fd: NV_ESC_REGISTER_FD permits one ctl_nvfp link per file-private object and rejects overwrite, self-link, or chaining. This is a file-lifetime association, not an RM-core selector.
client_lifetime.implication: Use a distinct nv_file_private_t/lifetime cleanup record per RM domain. Reusing one file-private pointer across two independently running cores risks asymmetric client cleanup; one stock cleanup traverses only one g_resServ.

stock_dispatch.observation: Each open gets an nv_file_private_t; control open uses module's nv_ctl_device. Kernel ioctl dispatch hands the current nv_state plus file-private pointer to rm_ioctl, which calls RmIoctl. No backend selector is added.

enumeration.observation: GET_ATTACHED_IDS returns contiguous local gpuId values plus invalid sentinels. SDK defines gpuId as opaque and platform-dependent. RmClientResource delegates to gpumgrGetAttachedGpuIds, which walks that RM's attached mask and returns its own pGpu->gpuId values.
enumeration.union_contract: Call GET_ATTACHED_IDS separately through each selected backend root and retain every entry as (backend, local_gpuId). Reconcile physical devices by stable external identity; do not concatenate/deduplicate raw gpuId values as if globally unique.
enumeration.stable_identity: SDK exposes GET_ID_INFO and GET_PCI_INFO controls; PCI info includes domain/bus/slot. Validate full PCI BDF or UUID for a public cross-backend identity.

child_handles.allocation_parameter: NV0080_ALLOC_PARAMETERS.deviceId is that backend's local GPU ID.
NV2080_ALLOC_PARAMETERS.subDeviceId is that backend's local subdevice index.

enumeration.limitation: All child/resource handles remain RM-domain scoped. A CUDA-facing merge still needs backend-tagged handles or translation for every object and nested handle payload; root-only behavior does not establish this.

next_experiment.name: Paired root-client create/control/free using two actual, state-isolated R580 RM callbacks
steps: Backend A: call NV_ESC_RM_ALLOC with NVOS21: hRoot=0, hObjectParent=0, hObjectNew=0, hClass=NV01_ROOT_CLIENT, pAllocParms=NULL, paramsSize=0.
Require status=NV_OK and hObjectNew != 0; retain as private candidate tagged backend A.
Backend B: same request but hRoot=backend_A_hObjectNew and hObjectNew=0. Require status=NV_OK and hObjectNew == backend_A_hObjectNew.
If transport is uncertain, either status is non-OK, or outputs disagree, quarantine. Do not free based only on a nonzero output from a failed allocation.
Only after successful, coherent allocation in both domains, issue one NVOS54 GET_ATTACHED_IDS query per backend, preserving returned IDs with backend tags.

If a confirmed-successful A root must be rolled back after B failure, send NVOS00 to A with hRoot=id, hObjectParent=0, hObjectOld=id. Otherwise free B then A in reverse order with the same matching hRoot/hObjectOld fields. If cleanup fails, quarantine.
next_experiment.pass_criterion: Demonstrate that each callback reaches a distinct RsServer state; exact mirrored root ID and coherent success statuses; per-domain control routing; successful reverse frees with no published partial pair.
fail_closed: Both callbacks reach the same stock g_resServ.
Requested ID collision/unavailable or returned ID mismatch.
Unknown transport outcome, non-success status, or ambiguous handle output.
One nv_file_private_t is shared without proven per-domain cleanup.
Root free must carry hRoot == hObjectOld == the successfully returned root ID in the same backend domain.
next_experiment.scope_boundary: Passing this experiment would validate root-client brokerage and root-level control/free only. It would not validate merged CUDA enumeration, device/subdevice allocation, UVM, memory, kernel execution, or hardware behavior.

limitations: Static source only; no access to PC3, no hardware test, no build, and no driver load/install.
Explicit root hClient acceptance is source-supported in this R580 configuration but remains untested at runtime.
Stock R580 has one global g_resServ/g_RmApiList; two isolated cores must be supplied by another design and cannot be inferred from two callbacks alone.
Same root ID does not prove equal child handles, unified CUDA ABI, memory interoperability, or runtime safety.
